integration_id.description: ID of the Slack integration (kind='slack') whose bot reads and replies in the thread.

item_id.description: ID of the resource the discussion is attached to.

scope.description: Resource type the discussion is attached to (e.g. Ticket).

url.description: Link to any message in the Slack thread, from Copy link in Slack, e.g. https://acme.slack.com/archives/C0123ABCDEF/p1767225636123456.
